exposure: Robson Ten Group Classification System categories (Groups 1-10)
cohort: The study included 221,098 deliveries from Ireland's four largest maternity hospitals between 2015 and 2021.
finding: The overall Caesarean Section rate in Ireland's largest maternity hospitals significantly increased from 30.13% in 2015 to 35.89% in 2021, primarily driven by increases in Robson Group 2 and Group 5.
mod_finding: The rising Caesarean Section rate was predominantly influenced by an increasing proportion of Group 2 and Group 5 deliveries and a higher Caesarean Section rate within Group 5.
